rawContent: @MjAllennn @GeorgeAddison87 Izzy is one of the few French actresses who did not speak against the #MeToo movement. Obviously, the French have a different attitude. As far as pulling down the pants of a model during a shoot, for example, I would have to know the context.

@MjAllennn @GeorgeAddison87 We need to not judge others based on what is reported as to their views on #MeToo as the comments may have been taken out of context. Even if not, that is his opinion. We need to stop crucifying people when their opinions differ from ours. This is becoming too McCarthy-like.
